author: einrikr
text:
The next post is sort of a addition to what was discussed recently, found in Salivan's journal.

In my opinion, it's a good way to read price on the way up, since it tells you lots!

Here goes:

1: Price broke through barrier, wants next.

2: Broke straight through, whats next.

3: Broken,

4: Broken immediately after, same with 5.

6: price touches it and retraces directly. This way, you'll know that
price is going down until it hits the next target, which you can find
the same way.

Not the quickest way to see live where price is bouncing but a fun exercise!

Now it's time to find out what makes that one a stronger level of
resistance, so that it's possible to anticipate on those levels.

author: einrikr
text:
My first ever TT!

Love it! 20R, pretty good start! Now, I have been monitoring this pair
for one and a half day and followed price very closely while shooting
back up. I've drawn boxes at possible reversal spots, just like in my
previous post and decided to exit when it touched the bar. After that it
 spiked up but went down anyway.

Now, I have to admit that I was not absolutely sure that this would work
 nor what I've done precisely but I'll keep on figuring that out.

And now for some gnocchi making!
